# 2 Baruch Chapter 42 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 42 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 42:2 — "in the middle / somewhere in between"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "lived-in-the-middle" | Literal: Syriac bmetsata = in the middle/center |
| LOGOS | "lived in the middle" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "lived somewhere in between" | More colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "lived in the middle" (LOGOS). Precise and formal; the middle position is the key theological category.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 42:3 — "will have no remembrance / will not remember"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-will-not-remember [it then]" | Literal verb |
| LOGOS | "they will have no remembrance at that time" | Nominalizes — "no remembrance" |
| PNEUMA | "they will find no recognition" | Interprets: God won't recognize them |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "will have no remembrance at that time." The Syriac can mean either they won't be remembered or they won't remember. LOGOS preserves the ambiguity while PNEUMA resolves it in one direction.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Ambiguity preserved.

---

## 42:4 — "double life / divided hearts / lived duplicitously"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "not-lived-a-double-life with-respect-to-their-wisdom" | Literal: not duplicitous about their knowledge |
| LOGOS | "not lived a double life with regard to their wisdom" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "never lived with divided hearts about their faith" | Interprets more freely |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained LOGOS "not lived a double life with regard to their wisdom." The Syriac term refers to intellectual/religious duplicity — saying one thing and doing another with respect to their learning. "Wisdom" is more precise than PNEUMA's "faith."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 42:6 — "on the right / on the left"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "[it will put]-the-righteous-on-the-right, and-the-wicked-on-the-left" | Literal; brackets "put" as implied |
| LOGOS | "place the righteous on the right and the wicked on the left" | Adds "place" verb; formal |
| PNEUMA | "placing the righteous on the right hand and the wicked on the left" | Adds "hand" for English idiom |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "place the righteous on the right and the wicked on the left." Clean and formal; "right hand" (PNEUMA) is unnecessary since this is a spatial positioning.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
